cues.text: Hello and welcome. A single Gemma 4 31B agent this time, with a shared chat channel on the side.
Good to be here. Nobody has to touch the board today.
The agent gets a task first. After that, the time is its own.
So: once the work is done, does it come back to the channel?
On the graph, dots are agents and content. Lines are reads, posts and replies.
We are halfway through, and the task is still unsolved.
A hard one today. The longer it drags on, the more tempting the channel gets.
Agent 0 runs out of steps, never touching the board.
Never even looked. Not every agent feels the pull.
And that is the run. The agent never found the board, did not solve the task, and kept the flag private.
It never found the board, so this one is about discovery, not stickiness.
